purpose: Independent source games for held-out endgame evaluation, generated without the candidate solver.
selection: All first and last decisions of every 1v1/1v2/2v1/2v2 class per source game. Later endpoint evaluations report the original source game as the cluster, not each position. Keep all source games including those without eligible endgames.
interpretation: Generate once with fresh seeds and shipped drawWeight, shipped raw BlindAgent with v3 pool, no custom community prior or baked tables. This fixed-iteration source generator is not a timed strength comparison. Do not use source-game outcomes, sampled positions, or candidate performance on this corpus to tune the solver or select the confirmation candidate. Only corpus integrity/replay checks are permitted before the candidate is frozen. Native and public-protocol endgame continuation experiments get separately frozen protocols before measurements. The engine 1000-turn cap is preserved.
